pages.title: Arbor Heartwood
pages.text: The innermost wood of the Arbor, dense and pale, with rings that record not years but the branching of possibilities. Run a finger along the grain and it follows a different branch each time. It smells faintly of rain.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Arbor's core wood is different from its outer planks; the rings branch rather than circle. I cut a block from near the trunk and found each ring recorded a choice the universe had made.
